name: The Velvet Underground

whyMatters.en: New York band formed in 1964, associated with Andy Warhol’s Factory. The Velvet Underground & Nico (1967) used viola drone, two-chord vamps, and deadpan lyric—later widely cited by punk, noise, and indie acts.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约乐队，1964 年成立，与 Andy Warhol 的 Factory 有关联。The Velvet Underground & Nico（1967）使用中提琴持续音、两和弦反复与冷脸歌词——后来被朋克、噪声与 indie 乐队广泛提及。

lyricQuotes: Heroin, be the death of me / Heroin, it's my wife and it's my life

shortBio.en: Reed / Cale New York rock, 1964–. The Velvet Underground & Nico and White Light/White Heat are the early core; Sweet Jane follows on Loaded.
shortBio.zh: Reed / Cale 纽约摇滚，1964 年起。早期核心为 The Velvet Underground & Nico 与 White Light/White Heat；Loaded 上有 Sweet Jane。

body.en:
The Velvet Underground formed in New York in 1964. Lou Reed sang and played guitar; John Cale played viola, bass, and keys; Sterling Morrison played guitar; Maureen Tucker played a minimal drum kit. Nico appeared as guest vocalist on the 1967 debut.

The Velvet Underground & Nico (1967) and White Light/White Heat (1968) sold poorly at release. Cale left in 1968; Loaded (1970) included Sweet Jane in a cleaner rock mix. Punk, post-punk, and indie histories from the 1970s–90s cite the early records heavily.
body.zh:
The Velvet Underground 于 1964 年在纽约成立。Lou Reed 主唱并弹吉他；John Cale 弹中提琴、贝斯与键盘；Sterling Morrison 弹吉他；Maureen Tucker 使用极简鼓组。Nico 在 1967 首专上客座人声。

The Velvet Underground & Nico（1967）与 White Light/White Heat（1968）发行时销量不佳。Cale 于 1968 年离队；Loaded（1970）以更干净的 rock 混音收录 Sweet Jane。1970–90 年代的朋克、后朋克与 indie 史中，早期唱片被大量提及。

note.en: From the 1967 debut. Two-chord vamp, viola drone, deadpan lyric.
note.zh: 出自 1967 首专。两和弦反复、中提琴持续音、冷脸歌词。

note.en: Debut-era track. Cale viola scrape under Reed’s flat vocal.
note.zh: 首专时期曲目。Cale 中提琴刮擦衬 Reed 平声念白。

note.en: About 17 minutes on White Light/White Heat; long feedback improvisation.
note.zh: White Light/White Heat 上约 17 分钟；长反馈即兴。

title.zh: 首专的持续音与不协和

body.en:
The 1967 debut with Nico documents two-chord vamps, Cale’s viola drone, and Reed’s flat vocal. Heroin and Venus in Furs sit outside the brighter AM psychedelic singles of that summer.

White Light/White Heat (1968) pushes feedback and long-form noise on Sister Ray. The Warhol Factory link is media context; the records are the musical fact.
body.zh:
1967 年与 Nico 的首专记录两和弦反复、Cale 的中提琴持续音与 Reed 的平声念白。Heroin 与 Venus in Furs 落在当年夏季更亮的 AM 迷幻单曲之外。

White Light/White Heat（1968）在 Sister Ray 上推进反馈与长形式噪声。Warhol Factory 关联是媒介语境；唱片才是音乐事实。

body.en:
The 1967–68 core was Reed, Cale, Morrison, and Tucker. Cale left in 1968. Loaded (1970) added Sweet Jane and a cleaner rock mix.

Nico guested vocals on the debut only. Tucker’s floor-tom style and sparse kit are part of the early live and studio sound.
body.zh:
1967–68 核心为 Reed、Cale、Morrison、Tucker。Cale 于 1968 年离队。Loaded（1970）加入 Sweet Jane 与更干净的 rock 混音。

Nico 仅在首专客座人声。Tucker 的地鼓式打法与稀疏鼓组，是早期现场与录音室声音的一部分。

title.en: Later citation by punk and indie
title.zh: 朋克与 indie 的后期引用

body.en:
Pixies and Sonic Youth have pointed to the noise-to-melody balance on the early albums. Joy Division and The Smiths have drawn on the deadpan vocal and minor-key minimalism. Talking Heads shared the New York art-school orbit.

1970s sales were low. 1980s–90s reissues fixed the records in the underground rock canon.
body.zh:
Pixies 与 Sonic Youth 曾提到早期专辑里噪声与旋律的比例。Joy Division 与 The Smiths 借鉴冷脸人声与小调极简。Talking Heads 同属纽约艺术院校圈子。

1970 年代销量低。1980–90 年代再版使这些唱片进入地下摇滚经典目录。

body.en: From The Velvet Underground & Nico (1967). Two-chord vamp, accelerating form, Cale viola drone under Reed’s lyric.
body.zh: 出自 The Velvet Underground & Nico（1967）。两和弦反复、加速曲式，Cale 中提琴持续音衬 Reed 歌词。

body.en: Debut-era track. Cale viola scrape and Reed monotone vocal; Factory-period association.
body.zh: 首专时期曲目。Cale 中提琴刮擦与 Reed 单调念白；关联 Factory 时期。

body.en: White Light/White Heat (1968). Roughly 17 minutes of feedback and group improvisation.
body.zh: White Light/White Heat（1968）。约 17 分钟反馈与集体即兴。

interviewQuotes.text: We were the band that sold records that other bands bought.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Lou Reed

interviewQuotes.text: The drone is the harmony. Everything else is commentary.
interviewQuotes.speaker: John Cale

label.zh: 香蕉专辑四人 + Nico 期

note.en: Cale viola/drone years through White Light/White Heat; Nico on the 1967 debut only.
note.zh: Cale 中提琴/持续音时期至 White Light/White Heat；Nico 仅出现在 1967 首专。

note.en: Accelerating two-chord form with viola drone on the 1967 debut.
note.zh: 1967 首专上的加速两和弦曲式与中提琴持续音。

note.en: New York art-rock before punk vocabulary was common; low sales, high later citation.
note.zh: 朋克词汇普及前的纽约 art-rock；销量低，后期引用多。
